title: Pan-Seared Fish with Croatian Stew
description: A flavorful fish dish served with a hearty Croatian stew. This recipe is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Fish (4 fillets, 6 oz each)
ingredients.notes: You can use any white fish, such as cod or tilapia.

ingredients.name: Croatian Stew Spice Mix (1 tsp)
ingredients.notes: You can make your own spice mix or use store-bought.

ingredients.name: Yellow Peppers (2)
ingredients.notes: Any color pepper will work, but yellow adds a nice sweetness.

instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Season the fish with salt, pepper, and Croatian Stew Spice Mix.
Add olive oil to the pan and sear the fish for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat a separate pan over medium heat and add sliced yellow peppers.
Cook the peppers for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Serve the fish with the peppers on the side.
Serve the stew on the side, or mix it in with the peppers and fish.
